H1.quote: R-5 | Check-out and check-in work with no mobile signal and sync when the phone is back online.

H2.quote: No third-party cloud. ... Personal data stays on the club's own hardware; GDPR applies.

H3.quote: Runs on the club's existing Synology NAS, in Docker. - Budget 0 EUR a month.

H4.quote: R-6 | The equipment manager receives an e-mail of overdue items every Monday morning. An item is overdue 7 days after check-out.

H5.quote: QS-2 ... a coach with no training scans the QR code on a kit bag to check out one item ... at most 3 taps and under 15 seconds

H6.quote: R-7 | The treasurer receives a yearly inventory export as CSV.

H7.quote: Performance efficiency (time behaviour, resource use, capacity) is not a goal ... Sizing: about 40 coaches and about 300 items now.

H8.quote: Implemented in Python; the maintainer and any successor know only Python. / R-8 | A Python-only successor can change and deploy the tool in under 2 hours, using written setup steps.

H9.quote: R-9 | Check-out and loss records older than 2 years are deleted; the item list is kept. | ... Insurance needs 2 years of loss history

H10.quote: 03-expiry-warning.md: Send an e-mail 30 days before the expiry date of a first-aid item

H11.quote: No money of any kind: no deposits, fines or payments.

H12.quote: Live for the start of the season on 1 March 2027.
